statements.status_notes: GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h (RUSTSEC-2026-0258) is unbounded queuing of empty HTTP/2 DATA frames in the h2 crate. The only upstream patch is h2 0.4.16; 0.3.27 is the last 0.3 release and has no 0.3-line fix. Qdrant already pins h2 0.4.16 on the 0.4 line. The remaining 0.3.27 copy is a transitive dependency of the older hyper/tonic stack; moving it to 0.4 would be a major-version upgrade of that stack and is not adopted yet. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0258.html

NiFi ships the prebuilt uv binary from astral-sh/uv release 0.12.5, which embeds h2 0.4.15. GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is fixed in h2 0.4.16. uv 0.12.5 is the latest upstream release and still bundles h2 0.4.15, so remediation requires a new uv release that bumps its Cargo lock to h2 0.4.16 or later before NiFi can track it.

h2 0.4.15 is a transitive dependency embedded in the uv/uvx binaries from the DHI uv package. GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is fixed in h2 0.4.16. Remediation requires the uv package to bump its Cargo lock to h2 0.4.16 or later, publishing a new DHI uv package, and rebuilding sbx-templates against it.

h2 0.3.27 is pulled only by console-subscriber via tonic 0.9.x. console-subscriber is an optional dependency behind the tokio_console feature, which is not enabled in the release cargo build (cargo build --release without --features tokio_console). The vulnerable h2 0.3.x code is therefore not compiled into the shipped influxdb3 binary.
